facts.text: The main pi session starts with anthropic claude-opus-5-5 at medium thinking, from defaultProvider, defaultModel and defaultThinkingLevel in config/pi/settings.json.
facts.hit: config/pi/settings.json sets the interactive session's defaults to the anthropic provider, model claude-opus-5-5 and thinking level medium.

facts.text: A read-only scout run defaults to anthropic/claude-sonnet-5-5 (MODEL in bin/scout) with low thinking (THINKING defaults to low in bin/scout).
facts.hit: Without --rw, scout uses the MODEL variable in bin/scout, anthropic/claude-sonnet-5-5, and falls back to low thinking.

facts.text: A scout --rw run defaults to WORKER_MODEL in bin/scout, which is also anthropic/claude-sonnet-5-5, with thinking raised to high.
facts.hit: In worker mode scout switches to WORKER_MODEL, again anthropic/claude-sonnet-5-5, and the default thinking becomes high instead of low.

facts.text: Defaults are overridden for one call by passing --model PROVIDER/ID and --thinking LEVEL (low, medium, high or xhigh) to scout.
facts.hit: For a single invocation, give scout the --model flag with a provider/id value and/or the --thinking flag with low, medium, high or xhigh.

decoys: scout --fork starts the child from a copy of the parent session, which re-bills the whole parent context.
scout --review BASE needs a clean working tree.
The minimalist section of config/pi/settings.json excludes the edit and write tools.
